messages.subject: Sean | Energy & Industrial Executive | ESG, Government Relations and International Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Sean,

Your executive-search work across industrial and energy, natural-resources and infrastructure leadership makes this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior international mandates where operating performance depends on government relations, ESG and disciplined stakeholder execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage and carbon-data readiness, giving me direct exposure to responsible industrial transition in a regulated operating environment.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership in mining, energy, infrastructure and industrial businesses. I am internationally mobile and open to Canada, the USA, the Middle East and other global assignments.

I have attached a Kestria Canada & USA-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for suitable current or upcoming searches.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
